title: Interest Days on a Prepaid Interest Dispute Excess (Closing and Funding)
content:
**Rule.** In a Closing and Funding prepaid interest dispute decision, the interest days on the excess are set as follows: where the decision comes later than the dispute response business days (30) after the filing date, they run from the disbursement date up to the decision date; where it comes later than the dispute acknowledgment business days (5) but no later than the dispute response business days after the filing date, they run from the filing date up to the decision date; otherwise there are none.

Business days for these deadlines are counted Monday through Friday starting with the day after the filing date, and the decision date is the day the decision is booked. A run "from" one date "up to" the decision date counts the calendar days by which the decision date follows the start date: the start date is counted and the decision date is not.

| Decision date relative to the filing date | Interest days |
|---|---|
| within 5 business days | none |
| more than 5 and no more than 30 business days after | from the filing date up to the decision date |
| more than 30 business days after | from the disbursement date up to the decision date |

## Example (hypothetical: disbursed 15 May, filed Monday 2 June)

Business day 5 is Monday 9 June; business day 30 is Monday 14 July.

| Decided on | Interest days |
|---|---|
| 9 June | none |
| 10 June | 2 June up to 10 June: 8 |
| 14 July | 2 June up to 14 July: 42 |
| 15 July | 15 May up to 15 July: 61 |
